description:
Design preview (Scripts/serve_designs.py on 127.0.0.1:8768, gallery.js, publish_designs.py) -- two asks from Jake:

1. AERO HAND OUT OF THE GRIPPER. The Aero Hand is its own separate family/folder (per AGENTS.md it attaches to the arm). Right now it also shows up as an option inside the generalist gripper. Remove it from the gripper's options so it only appears under its own Aero Hand family.

2. SIMPLIFY THE LANDING PAGE. Jake: 'It's getting a little out of hand.' When you first land on the Helping Hands live site it should be just a file-selector-style sidebar on the side (part families -> versions as a tree) plus the main view. Strip the clutter from the landing page. Jake is still deciding what the main area should say on landing -- leave a simple placeholder; the landing text will come in a follow-up reply on this pebble.

TESTS/CHECKS: add a test or check that the Aero Hand is not listed under the gripper's options, and that the landing page renders the sidebar selector (tree of families/versions).
test_instructions: Open the live design preview landing page: only a sidebar tree of part families/versions plus a placeholder main area
Expand the generalist gripper: Aero Hand is not among its options; it appears only under its own family

results.identified_issue:
Jake's mid-pebble update replaced the original "sidebar tree plus placeholder" ask: the landing is the Parts view listing Gripper, Handle, Base, Mount, Arm with a version selector per row, dependencies handled (update or flag), plus the 3D view and nothing else; the Aero Hand stays its own family. Recorded in cad/mobile_gallery/README.txt.

Mechanism: cad/mobile_gallery/model.js holds the catalog logic (part versions, options per row, buildMix, mixFlags) with no DOM or three.js so Node can test it; gallery.js only renders. MIX.parts is the row order and the first part is mandatory; AERO_MIX is ['aero','mount','arm'] so the Aero Hand never reaches a Generalist row (the old PICKERS list was shared by both mixes). Dependency rule: mixFlags returns {key, other, text} pairs; buildMix(changed) re-picks only FOLLOWERS (handles, mount), newest version that clears every flag involving it, and records a "follows" note; other parts keep a flag shown on the affected row (the one not just changed). Picks never cascade to 'none'. The first build (picks null) settles adapters silently; a refresh never moves a pick, so a deliberately mismatched pick stays flagged. Two pre-existing bugs fixed on the way: takes() compared undefined tool_plate to undefined carries.Mount so a hand-held Base never flagged against a Mount; the Aero Hand was checked against the Arm directly though the Mount sits between (dropped, the Mount is checked against the Arm).

Deleted: header dropdown (family select moved to the panel head), Hide… dialog (hidden.json is still read; design_visibility.py CLI still writes it), All button, Top/Front/Side/Iso buttons (?view= still works), refresh button (5-minute auto refresh stays), in-tile mixer selects and amber flag bar, Parts open/close (the panel is always open), the Actual photo tile and its PHOTOS import (reference/ files kept, unused now). A mix family shows only its assembly; a hash to one of its versions, or a row's Tune button, shows that version alone with a back row. Non-mix families (Glove, Orca, Your hand) list versions in the panel and still show the side-by-side grid.

Chose not to: auto-switch the Base when the Mount changes (it is the design under study; the first run did this and it was jarring), delete reference/ photos, or turn Arm and Mount on by default (the arm dwarfs the gripper). Verified: Scripts/test_gallery.py (5 tests: Node model checks + headless Chrome landing render through serve_designs.py), screenshots of the real catalog at 1280x800 and 390x844. Not verified on the phone through Pebbles. Scripts/test_gripper_poses.py fails on v306 (no poses.js entry); pre-existing, untouched here. cad/mobile_gallery/package.json ({"type":"module"}) exists only so Node runs model.js; the publisher does not copy it.
results.summary: The preview now lands on the parts list beside the 3D view, and the Aero Hand is no longer a Generalist option.
results.detailed_description:
Your spec, as recorded: the landing is the parts list beside the 3D view and nothing else. It lists the Generalist assembly top to bottom, Gripper, Handle, Base, Mount, Arm, each row at its current version with a selector to switch it; swapping a part updates or flags the parts it affects; the Aero Hand stays its own family. That is now what loads, and it is written into cad/mobile_gallery/README.txt.

Dependencies work like this: the adapter parts follow a change (switch the Arm to 2 and the Mount moves to 2 with a green "Mount 2 follows Arm 2" under its row; pick Gripper 20 and the Handle moves to the one built on it). Anything else that no longer fits gets an amber flag under the affected row instead (a hand-held Base under a Mount, a Base built on other fingers). Nothing is ever switched off for you. Each part's pieces still hang under its row with the eye and Only, and Tune sits on the rows whose version has parameters.

Gone: the header dropdown (the family picker is now the top of the list), Hide, All, the Top/Front/Side/Iso buttons, the refresh button, the pickers inside the tile and the photo tile. Arm and Mount start off, as before. Tests: Scripts/test_gallery.py checks the rows and the Aero Hand's absence under Node and renders the landing in headless Chrome. I could not check it on the phone through Pebbles; the launch agent picks the new files up on its next five-minute publish.

summary: The Aero Hand appears as an option inside the generalist gripper in the design preview, though it is its own separate family. The landing page should be simplified to a families-to-versions tree sidebar plus a placeholder main view, with the Aero Hand only under its own family.
